lines.zh: 我踮着脚尖，一步一步走过来。
lines.en: On tiptoe, I come forward step by step.

lines.zh: 裙子是粉白羊毛拼的，很扎人。
lines.en: My skirt is pink and white wool. It itches.
Three steps, then a spin.

lines.zh: 尾巴翘着，我一路扭过去。
lines.en: Tail up, I sashay along.

lines.zh: 我脚下踩着节拍，一二三四。
lines.en: I keep time underfoot: one, two, three, four.

lines.zh: 我从舞台上走下来，往你那边。
lines.en: I come down off the stage, heading your way.

lines.zh: 每一步都要稳，不然裙子会歪。
lines.en: Each step must be sure or my skirt skews.

lines.zh: 我绕着空地走半圈，找位置。
lines.en: I cross half the clearing looking for a spot.
I hop and land back on my toes.

lines.zh: 观众在哪儿？我到处看看。
lines.en: Where's the audience? I look about.

lines.zh: 我边走边抬手，摆个姿势。
lines.en: I raise an arm mid-walk and strike a pose.
I stop and let you move first.
I stand on my toes, perfectly still.
I give my skirt a shake.

lines.zh: 我在数拍子，没人给我伴奏。
lines.en: I count beats. No one's playing for me.
I lift one leg and hold it.

lines.zh: 粉白的毛有点乱，我理了理。
lines.en: The pink and white wool's mussed; I smooth it.

lines.zh: 我歪头看着空荡荡的台子。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the empty stage.

lines.zh: 我转了一圈，裙子飞起来。
lines.en: I spin once and my skirt flares.
I'm tired, but I can't sit.
I groom my face with a paw.

lines.zh: 我数着观众，一个也没有。
lines.en: I count the audience. None.

lines.zh: 我踮着脚等下一段音乐。
lines.en: I wait on my toes for the next music.
I bring my toes together evenly.

lines.zh: 我把爪子放在腰上，等人来。
lines.en: I put a paw on my hip and wait.

lines.zh: 我脚尖有点麻，换只脚站。
lines.en: One foot's gone numb; I switch.

lines.zh: 我对着空台子行了个礼。
lines.en: I bow to the empty stage.

lines.zh: 我在练一段不需要音乐的舞。
lines.en: I'm practicing a dance with no music.

lines.zh: 你坐前排吗？我这就开始。
lines.en: Front row? I'll begin.
I tilt my head at you. You smiled.
Don't clap. I haven't danced yet.

lines.zh: 你身上没有粉色的东西。
lines.en: You've nothing pink on you.
I lift my chin, quite proud.
You're standing too near the front.
Let me spin for you.
Clap and I'll dance another.

lines.zh: 我的裙子，你觉得好看吗？
lines.en: My skirt — do you like it?

lines.zh: 你不说话，我就当你喜欢。
lines.en: You're quiet, so I'll take that as yes.

lines.zh: 我伸出一只爪，请你上来。
lines.en: I offer a paw for you to join me.
Waiting for the show too?
On tiptoe I reach only your waist.

lines.zh: 你笑得太大声了，我会忘拍子。
lines.en: Laugh that loud and I'll lose the beat.
My skirt's been messed up.
I stumble and rise again.
My toes hurt and I can't balance well.
There's dust on my pink wool.
I grit my teeth and keep counting.

lines.zh: 我的裙子转起来，才叫舞。
lines.en: My skirt must spin for it to be a dance.
I retreat to the edge and reset my pose.

lines.zh: 粉毛上落了灰，我拍了拍。
lines.en: Dust on my pink wool; I pat it off.

lines.zh: 我可是舞者，不会轻易倒。
lines.en: I'm a dancer. I don't fall easily.
I'll put that into the dance.
Pink wool. I know it.

lines.zh: 那颜色和我的裙子一样。
lines.en: That color matches my skirt.
Give it here and I'll do a spin.
I like soft things.
Hold it to the light so I can see the pink.
I reach out, still on my toes.

lines.zh: 这料子能做一条新裙边。
lines.en: This would make a new hem.
I hug it and won't let go.
Don't put it away. I'm not done looking.
You're kind. I'll remember.
Ow, my toes!

lines.zh: 我一个旋转，裙摆还没散。
lines.en: One spin, and my skirt still holds.
My skirt's askew; I tug it straight.
I step back and rise onto my toes again.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞到我的尾巴。
lines.en: Your knee hit my tail.
I wobble, but I don't fall.
Don't push. I can't balance like this.

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪了一步，让你过去。
lines.en: I sidestep to let you pass.
That bump didn't unseat me.
You're standing on my hem.
Let me finish this dance first.
Can you keep time?

lines.zh: 我这种舞者，一天到晚在转。
lines.en: A dancer like me spins all day.

lines.zh: 你得扶着我的腰，我才不晕。
lines.en: Hold my waist or I get dizzy.

lines.zh: 我们两个转起来，谁也停不住。
lines.en: Once we spin together, neither can stop.
My skirt is far too scratchy.
When the music stops, we'll talk.

lines.zh: 你愿意看我跳一整晚吗？
lines.en: Would you watch me dance all night?

lines.zh: 我踮着脚，靠不到你肩上。
lines.en: On my toes I still can't reach your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们跳一段，就当认识了。
lines.en: One dance and we're acquainted.
This wool is mine.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时脚尖还没落地。
lines.en: I bend without my toes touching down.
I hold it as if it were flowers.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，正合我意。
lines.en: Something dropped. How convenient.
I pinch it up with a paw. Very light.
This color goes with my hem.
I put it under my feet. Soft.

lines.zh: 捡东西也是舞蹈的一部分。
lines.en: Picking things up is part of the dance.

lines.zh: 我转一圈，东西就到了爪里。
lines.en: One spin and it's in my paw.
Keep it for the next performance.
Where's that applause? I heard it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，脚尖已经对准。
lines.en: I fix on you, toes pointed your way.
You're the only one standing in the audience.
I choose you to come up and dance.

lines.zh: 你的位置，正好在我的舞步里。
lines.en: You're standing right in my steps.
I tilt my head and smile.
Don't go. I'm not finished.
I'll count to eight and you should move.
I spin to face you squarely.

lines.zh: 你被我盯上了，这是荣幸。
lines.en: You're my pick. Be flattered.
I raise a hand into the opening pose.

lines.zh: 台下就你一个，我就选你。
lines.en: You're the only one here, so you'll do.

lines.zh: 我一步一步靠近，踩着拍子。
lines.en: I approach step by step, in time.
Right. Locked on.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，裙子飞起来。
lines.en: I circle you and my skirt flares.

lines.zh: 你的脚不知道该往哪放。
lines.en: Your feet don't know where to go.
I close in on tiptoe, very quietly.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，全乱了。
lines.en: I count your steps. All off beat.
I reach; you give half a step.

lines.zh: 我侧身一转，就到了你侧面。
lines.en: One turn and I'm at your flank.
You've backed to the stage edge.
One hop closes the gap.
You're watching my feet, not my hands.

lines.zh: 这一圈绕完，你就没地方了。
lines.en: When this circle closes, you've nowhere.
One more step and I'm where you are.

lines.zh: 我踮得更高了，准备起跳。
lines.en: I rise higher on my toes, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 我转圈，粉羊毛做的裙摆。
lines.en: I spin in a skirt of pink wool.
The music hasn't stopped, so neither do I.
Pretty, isn't it? This is the last circle.

lines.zh: 我抬腿一踢，正中你的膝盖。
lines.en: I snap a leg out and catch your knee.
That one came with a spin.

lines.zh: 我爪子抓了一下你的袖子。
lines.en: My paw catches your sleeve.
I sweep my skirt across your eyes.
I leap and land on your shoulder.
Light as a beat.

lines.zh: 我撞完就转开，你打不到。
lines.en: I hit and spin away; you can't land one.
You staggered, and I laughed.

lines.zh: 这一脚是八拍里的重音。
lines.en: That kick is the accent in the bar.
I hop behind you and kick again.

lines.zh: 我从台后踮着脚走出来。
lines.en: I come out from behind the stage on my toes.

lines.zh: 粉白羊毛做的我，一身扎。
lines.en: Made of pink and white wool, and all scratchy.

lines.zh: 台下没人，我还是先站好。
lines.en: No one in the seats, but I take my place.

lines.zh: 我把脚尖立起来，试了试地。
lines.en: I rise on my toes and test the floor.
Flat enough here. I can dance.

lines.zh: 粉色的我在灰地上很显眼。
lines.en: Pink as I am, I stand out on gray ground.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬胳膊，活动关节。
lines.en: I lift my arms and loosen them.

lines.zh: 十六块粉羊毛，五块白的，就这些。
lines.en: Sixteen pink wool, five white. That's all of me.

lines.zh: 灯没开，我就自己数拍子。
lines.en: No lights, so I'll count my own time.

lines.zh: 我理了理裙摆，准备出场。
lines.en: I smooth my skirt and prepare to enter.
I've got the first measure in my head.
Right. Begin.
I fluff the wool so it looks right.
I settle at the center of the stage.
Wool curls at flame. I'm afraid of it.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，脚尖先着地。
lines.en: I fall from high and land on my toes.
Waterlogged, my skirt drags me down.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀得转了好几圈。
lines.en: The blast spins me several times over.
An arrow passes through my skirt.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的舞步乱了。
lines.en: That force breaks my steps.
Hungry, my legs go soft and I can't dance.
Lightning hits and I go numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地面，我找不到支点。
lines.en: No floor in the void. Nothing to balance on.
